featured_reviews.review_text:
I often watch movies at Miraj Cinemas Dattani, mainly because it’s convenient and close by. If you don’t want to travel far and just want to catch a movie nearby, it does the job.
That said, you do have to compromise a bit on the overall experience. The sound and screen quality are decent but not premium, and the seating comfort could definitely be better. The overall ambience feels slightly outdated compared to newer cinemas in other areas.
Cleanliness is acceptable and the staff is fine, but nothing really stands out. It’s more about convenience than a high-end cinematic experience.

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: The theater has comfortable chairs with ample leg space, and the place is clean and well-maintained. Each seat has a QR code to order food easily, which is then delivered directly to your seat. During the interval, staff also come around to take snack orders, making the experience hassle-free. The AC is perfectly set, not too hot and not too cold. Also both the screen and sound quality are also good

featured_reviews.review_text: My sister in law booked recliner seats, which are by the way the most expensive seats at the theater and when we reached for the show, the seats were dirty and two of our seats were torn and the cotton stuffing was all over the place. There was a beer bottle also. We informed the staff, they cleaned the seats for us that's all they could do. Didn't expect to pay and get torn seats.  The AC was not working. There were so many mosquitoes. The plugs where the recliners were connected were in bad state and almost broken. Highly disappointed.

featured_reviews.review_text: Miraj Cinema at Dattani Mall in Vasai is a cinematic delight! The state-of-the-art facilities combined with impeccable service make it the ultimate destination for movie buffs. The plush seating and crystal-clear screens elevate the movie-watching experience to new heights. The staff are friendly and efficient, ensuring a seamless experience from ticket booking to popcorn munching. Whether you're catching the latest blockbuster or indulging in a classic film, Miraj Cinema delivers top-notch entertainment. Plus, the convenient location within Dattani Mall makes it easily accessible. If you're in Vasai and craving a dose of cinematic magic, Miraj Cinema at Dattani Mall is the place to be! Highly recommended for an unforgettable movie-going experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)

featured_reviews.name: Dj Anu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Even the food was a letdown. The ₹100 sandwich was pathetic — dry, swaggy, and didn’t even have proper butter applied. Completely not worth the price.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket Waghmare
featured_reviews.review_text: Overall Experience is Good, Seats are comfortable but some reclining seats not working properly.  Parking is available for Bike & Car (2 wheeler or 4 wheeler) in basement for bike 20 rs parking charges. Security guards not checking properly, anyone can carry outside food inside theater.

featured_reviews.name: Anish Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Theatre, Borivali offers a consistently enjoyable movie-watching experience. The ambience is pleasant, seating is comfortable, and the overall layout of the theatre is well maintained, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a film.
Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

featured_reviews.name: Khushbu Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great movie experience at Maxus Cinemas, Borivali! The screens are bright, the sound quality is excellent, and the seats are super comfortable. The staff is polite and the theatre is always well-maintained. It’s one of the best cinemas in Borivali for a fun and relaxed movie outing with family or friends. Definitely recommend this place for its clean ambience and value-for-money experience.

featured_reviews.name: Krish Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Cinema Borivali completely ruined our experience.
I booked 2 Gold Couple seats, and one recliner was broken. The staff made us wait 25 minutes without any urgency or responsibility.

The canteen guy was extremely rude and was refusing to refund the snacks we purchased. Only after arguing did they process the refund, shocking behaviour from a cinema staff member.

Supervisor Arjun Rathod handled the issue very poorly and provided no real solution.
(Attached image: the staff member present at the time, wearing a white shirt and teal trousers.)

Manager Sukhmil was the only helpful person, but even he had to step in because the rest of the team was completely incompetent.

Pathetic service, untrained staff, and totally unprofessional behaviour. Never coming back.

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
An average multiplex, going with Vasai standards and number of people visiting it.
It is situated on the third floor of Dreams mall in Evershine city, a prime location.
Almost all Bollywood and Hollywood movies are shown over here. It never house full or very crowded.
Total three screens, spacious theatre and medium size screen.
Sitting arrangement is ok. Push back seats are there. You can find many Vasai people keeping their feet on front chair.
Ticket price is average and affordable.
Food court inside the theatre premises is ok and it sells popcorns, Samosa, Domino pizza, cold drinks etc.
Downside is the lift is on the back of the mall and you have to walk the distance. Mall escalators are not in working condition.
Another downside is the price of popcorn, samosa and cold drink is high and they don't allow you to carry your food hence it is advised to have food at home and then come for movie.
Visit this theatre if you don't have more options.

featured_reviews.name: Zoya Khatoon
featured_reviews.review_text:
While the overall setup and facilities were good, the experience was disappointing due to the atmosphere inside the theatre. The crowd was excessively loud throughout the movie, with constant talking and disturbances that made it difficult to stay immersed in the film. For the amount spent on tickets, I expected a much more enjoyable and comfortable viewing experience.

It would really help if stricter monitoring is enforced during screenings—perhaps with staff conducting periodic checks or clear announcements requesting audiences to maintain silence. Better crowd management and ensuring basic theatre etiquette would go a long way in improving the experience for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Mhapankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently went for an evening show of De De Pyaar De 2, and it turned out to be a great choice. The movie was full of comedy, light moments, and entertainment — we enjoyed every bit of it.

After the movie, we headed to the food court to grab something to eat. We tried their pizza and red sauce pasta, both of which were tasty and satisfying. For drinks, we had orange juice and strawberry bubbles — refreshing and perfect after a long movie.

Overall, it was a fun and enjoyable outing with good entertainment and good food. Would definitely recommend both the movie and the food court experience!

featured_reviews.name: Prem Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This movie theatre is located very close to the area, making it a highly convenient option for regular visits. One of the best things about this place is that it feels quite pocket-friendly, especially when compared to some of the bigger multiplex chains. However, it’s always a good idea to compare the pricing and features with PVR before making a final decision, particularly if looking for a more premium movie experience.

The seating arrangement here is surprisingly good for the price point. The regular seats offer decent comfort and support throughout the movie. That said, the sofa seats are not really worth the extra money – they don't add significant value in terms of comfort or luxury, so it's better to stick with the standard seating options.

The staff at this theatre are well-behaved and helpful. Their treatment of visitors is polite and respectful. One standout feature is their on-seat food service, which is quick and makes the experience more enjoyable.

The theatre is located in Nalasopara, making it a great choice for locals. Both the screen quality and sound system exceed expectations for this price range. For a budget-friendly yet satisfying cinematic experience, this theatre is definitely worth considering.

Worst Cinema in Virar

Absolutely terrible experience at Rockstar Cinema, Virar.

Right from the entrance, there was no proper security. Instead of trained staff, a little girl was casually asking for tickets, which felt completely unprofessional and unsafe.

As soon as we entered the cinema hall area, there was a horrible stench—like a rotten rat had died somewhere. When we informed the staff, instead of fixing the issue, they just sprayed some air freshener, which made it even worse.

I had booked an M Gold ticket, but the seat was broken. I had to adjust uncomfortably throughout the movie because no staff member was willing to help or even bother.

During the National Anthem, there was no sound at all. People just stood up and sat down in silence, completely ruining the experience and showing zero respect for the moment.

The food counter was equally disappointing—nothing was available. No samosa, no water, no cold drinks, no popcorn. The only thing they had was stale nachos with oily mayonnaise, which looked completely inedible.

Overall, a very disappointing and frustrating experience. Poor management, lack of basic facilities, and no concern for customers. Definitely not visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshi Naudiyal
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great movie experience at MovieMax Cinema. The screens are clear, sound quality is excellent, and seating is comfortable. The place is clean and well managed, and the staff is polite and helpful. A perfect spot to enjoy movies with friends or family!

featured_reviews.name: Mandar Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the worst movie experiences ever. Even though the screen was technically working, the quality was terrible. The display was dull, unclear, and completely ruined the cinematic experience. What’s the point of a “working” screen if it doesn’t deliver proper brightness or clarity? For the ticket price they charge, this level of quality is unacceptable. Definitely not worth watching a movie here.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: The theatre is good screaming is good, but the additional service they provide are really worst. The organisation does not look on it carefully, we booked platinum seats and we were provided with waterfall services . But then they provided with a new seat. they need to look on it care fully

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the New Cinema Theatre opened near Virar East RTO.  It has two screes. One is big and other is medium size. It is situated just Opposite HDIL and entrance is from backside of Riddhi Siddhi Indus.est. Theatre is very neat and clean and well decorated from inside. Seats are very comfortable and screen size and Sound quality is also very good. Washroom and toilets are also clean and well maintained. Prices of tickets are also very economical. It has only cons that it is situated very far from Virar Railway station. However you'll get share Autos from Station for HDIL or RTO.

featured_reviews.name: PRASAD PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text: The heater was very small but they have free screen. Sitting arrangement was awesome, sound & screen are good. Also the Food counter of is available. In menu they have four flavoured of popcorns samosa and cold drinks available there with Tea / coffee also. I will suggest go and enjoy with family and friends in the theatre

featured_reviews.name: Pritam Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Watched Hanu-Man on Sat 20th which is 2nd week after its release. Print quality look like cam print. no proper colour grading, some people complained abt this but ans from management was Wait for 10 min print will be better. But truth is print was really pathetic whole movie look like bad quality. They just ruined Hanu-man movie quality. This happend first time after watched more than 10 other movies in this theater. No such glitch I have ever experienced.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Kelkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent viewing experience at Movie Max Cinema. Superb Picture quality, dynamic sound system. Just like own mini theatre and at really affordable price...
